title: Cybersecurity analyst
_note: Technical round built from the Cybersecurity analyst tasks in content/reference/occupations.json, which the team wrote from the eMASCO title (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2531-04) and has not yet checked against the eMASCO task list. Behavioural round: behavioural.json. Rubric format: content/interview/sets.ts.

questions.text: What signs would make you think a system or network is under attack, and how would you watch for them?
questions.why: attacks found early do far less damage.
questions.source: 2531-04 task 1 (content/reference/occupations.json): Watch systems and networks for signs of attack. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

questions.text: A staff member clicked a phishing link and entered their password. What would you do, step by step?
questions.why: fast, calm incident response limits the harm.
questions.source: 2531-04 task 2 (content/reference/occupations.json): Investigate security incidents and help the organisation recover. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

questions.text: How would you find weaknesses in a system before attackers do, and how would you report them?
questions.why: fixing weaknesses first is cheaper than recovering from an attack.
questions.source: 2531-04 task 3 (content/reference/occupations.json): Find weaknesses and recommend fixes before they are exploited. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.
